blurb: In 1955, the Davenport House (c. 1820) was slated for demolition to make way for a parking lot. A group of seven determined women halted the demolition, purchased the house, and founded the Historic Savannah Foundation (HSF). What began as an effort to protect one home sparked a preservation movement that would go on to save an entire city.
